lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately five vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with the largest blobs concentrated in the mid-lateral region forming a staggered grid arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white spots, forming localized grid-like intersections across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three prominent horizontal ridges are visible across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal surface and distinct shadows on the ventral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin visible in the lower right quadrant contains a high density of small-diameter high-luminance spots, significantly smaller and more closely packed than the primary lateral flank markings.
